text:
alice: Heads up — after last night's eu-west firmware rollout I'm seeing ~6 racks failing GPU provisioning. Several BMCs reported Secure Boot state flipped and iDRAC sessions are spiking. Putting notes here so we can triage quickly.

ben: Seen on rack-r4 and r9. Provisioner gets to 'waiting for driver' then times out. Reprovision attempts hang at 30%.

carla: Quick paste from mgmt logs, looks like a signature validation mismatch and session throttle:
```
2026-03-19T02:11:05Z [iDRAC] auth_failure: signature_verify_failed image=bios-eu-west-v2.bin key_id=rotated-key-2026
2026-03-19T02:11:07Z [iDRAC] sessions=48 limit=40
2026-03-19T02:14:21Z [provisioner] gpu-provisioner: timeout waiting for /dev/nvidia0
```

dmitri: We rotated the BIOS signing key in the image repo yesterday as part of the integrity updates. We assumed devices would accept the old key for the grace period but looks like some BMCs validated against the new manifest only. Could be a manifest propagation race.

alice: Confirmed we rotated the signing key (KMS rotate) at 23:40 UTC. We had a 2h grace plan but maybe some iDRACs polled the manifest after the prune.

ben: ops-bot shows rollback succeeded for r4 and r10 but r5 still failing. What's in the rollback runbook?

carla: Relevant commands I ran on a failing host:
```
# check BMC boot options and secureboot state
racadm getconfig -g cfgServerInfo -o cfgServerBootOptions
# sample output
SecureBoot=Disabled
BootMode=UEFI
# ipmi check
ipmitool mc info
# sample
Device ID              : 32
Firmware Revision      : 2.00
```
Looks like secureboot reported disabled after the update, even though images were signed. Might be the BMC rejected the signature and toggled the flag.

ops-bot: ALERT: iDRAC connection throttle triggered on eu-west - 13 auth failures in last 60m. Affected hosts: r4,r5,r7,r9,r10,r12. Auto-rollback attempted on r4,r10.

dmitri: Proposal: pause the firmware rollout for eu-west immediately, redeploy a manifest that includes both old and new signing keys (dual-key manifest), then re-run a staged rollout. Also increase iDRAC session limit temporarily to avoid throttle causing further flaps.

alice: Agreed — pausing now. Quick cost note: reprovisioning these racks will re-run GPU boot + image fetches and we expect ~6 racks * 4hrs each queued = ~24 extra GPU-hours on the queue. Ballpark cost ~1.6k USD if we reprovision everything. Approve to proceed with dual-key manifest?

ben: +1 to dual-key manifest and pause. Starting rollback/runbook for remaining racks.

carla: I'll open a change to bump concurrent iDRAC sessions to 50 for eu-west during the remediation window and notify security. Also prepping a signed-manifest with both keys.

deploybot: action: rollout paused for eu-west by alice. Tickets: INFRA-4729 (rollback), INFRA-4730 (manifest dual-key), INFRA-4731 (iDRAC session bump).

alice: Good. Keep this thread updated with any hosts that fail to rollback. If any node stays stuck after rollback we'll escalate to oncall SRE for manual console.

ben: Noted. I'll paste per-rack status here as I go.
